liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): The second-set Eyes opener is jazzy and sweet, making the show worthwhile; Ranked among the better Eyes of the nineties, with jazzy solos, good tempo and a MIDI solo [8][13][16]
- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): Rescued the second set after Lazy River Road; The crowd sang the lyrics along with Bobby, and the Omni lights beamed across the arena [9][18]
- **Me and My Uncle** (1 review): Rescued the first set after So Many Roads, which the listener was hearing for the first time [9]
- **Maggie's Farm** (1 review): Things don't quite click at the end of Maggie's [10]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): The beginning of Bird Song doesn't quite click before the band settles in [10]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bob sang with special passion; the listener calls it a real highlight [9]

## The recordings

- **gd93-03-20.akg586.gardner.3385.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is very listenable, though not the very best audience tape; Audience recording is great with EQ applied; Mics have striking dynamic range, capturing deep bass and Jerry's guitar on Watchtower, Standing on the Moon and Saturday Night [8][14][15]
- **gd93-03-20.sbd.miller.28428.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 3.45/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has some hiss, rated three stars for sound, but Jerry's guitar sounds energetic and immersed [10]
- **gd1993-03-20.151663.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 156 min [6]
- **gd1993-03-20.151158.sbd.miller.flac2448**: soundboard; 19 songs; 156 min [7]

## Around the show

- Performance has a few loose moments, but the last four songs catch fire [14]
- Atlanta shows drew many musician friends of the band, including Dave Schools, Col. Bruce Hampton, Warren Haynes, Pete Buck and Mike Mills [15]
- Some snow remained in Atlanta from a freak storm; a trip to the snowed-out Cleveland show a week earlier was abandoned [16]
- Listener flew from Philly for March 20 and 21 and ran into Ted Turner and Hanoi Jane [19]
- Reviewer calls this Eyes among the better 1990s versions [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-03-20.akg586.gardner.3385.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tony Gardner; source: Audience: AKG 568's [1]. Also: Taped with AKG 568 shotgun mics into a Sony D3; master DATs went to CDR, then EAC, then SHN, via Tony Gardner [1]
- **gd93-03-20.sbd.miller.28428.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD> Dat> Cassette Master> Dat> CD> EAC> SHN> WAV> Samplitude Professional v8.0> FLAC; plus patch from FOB Soundfield AMS ST250 source; Edited By Charlie Miller [5]
- **gd1993-03-20.151663.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 11, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [6]
- **gd1993-03-20.151158.sbd.miller.flac2448**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 11, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [7]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Dick Latvala made the cassette transfer, with tape-flip overlaps needing no patches [7]
